classification: TASK-038 fix of slice194: a click on the picture (the gt4-gs child window) no longer leaves the game window inactive. gt4-gs.exe 0.3.1 gives the foreground back to the game window after every click (input queues stay detached; no HTTRANSPARENT); the game sets the keyboard focus to its own window on every activation in pcsx2 mode. Otherwise as slice194: the slice193 live PCSX2 GS build with readback modes (GT4_GS_READBACK accurate|unsynchronized -> HWDownloadMode), readback wait histograms in F8, the gt4-gs data root and shader cache in private/slice193-gt4gs-{data,cache} (0.2.0 used Documents\PCSX2), deferred swap chain acquire (GT4_GS_EAGER_ACQUIRE=1 restores the eager acquire), child window hardening (input queues detached, zero-size resizes ignored, WM_CLOSE halts before the window is destroyed) and crash handling (grace VSYNCs for the card flush, restart offer with CoreGS 1.1, handshake timeout message). gt4-gs.exe 0.3.0 from the GPL fork moesuito/gt4recomp-gs branch gt4gs/window.
preserved_inputs: Same runtime capsule (slice191-gs-stream-runtime), port (slice191-gs-stream-port), shaders (slice153-pacing-shaders), EE library, VU1 and VU0 tables as slice191/193/194; changed: native/gs_stream/gs_stream_client.cpp, native/window.cpp (WM_CLOSE in pcsx2 mode), native/CMakeLists.txt (GT4_GS_STREAM_CLIENT), tools/gs_live_check.
limits: Unsynchronized readbacks answer from the PCSX2 GS local memory copy: GPU-drawn pixels are stale (zeros in the gs_live_check sprite test), so the night-race lens flare may change; accurate is the default.
Deferred swap chain acquire and detached input queues are checked only with hidden windows; the owner checks the visible window (fullscreen, Alt+Tab, minimize).
Settings: only the minimal gt4-gs.ini (scale, blending High, deinterlace Automatic, aspect, vsync, readback mode); TASK-039.
gt4-gs.exe still contains the PCSX2 recompilers and the software renderer JIT (TASK-042).
Save states are refused in pcsx2 mode.
